critical_review.key_safety: check.ail reads the file and passes the key only in HTTP headers. Its only output is lineOf(provider,status); response bodies and transport errors are discarded, and the module imports no write primitive. The launch uses scrubbed descriptors and env -i; args contain the file path, not key text. UI uses a secret edit, clears it on save, shows only right(4) in the masked label and uses fixed tooltips. Automation start guard precedes plan construction/override. Baseline/mutants validate exact output, auth headers, absent key text and extra-file detection.
critical_review.threading: Worker performs spawn/read/timeout kill off the main thread. Both pipes are nonblocking. A mutex protects the finished queue; poll copies and clears it under the mutex, unlocks before joining tasks or emitting done, and updates results per provider. Empty stdout plus exited pid triggers one final read and immediate break, avoiding repeated queries of a reaped pid. Rapid-exit, concurrent-provider, stdout-cap, hung-child and stderr-flood probes found no new functional defect.
critical_review.badge_and_panel: State precedence remains off > ceiling > problem > working > live. Failures include production cancels and reset on success; budget is a distinct ceiling state. Visible panel follows indicator.refresh, usage remains session-scoped, dots are bounded/newest-last, slider round-trips all 1996 cent steps, and card results match the checked key. Shared title and ship-demo openers are exercised by the 111-check title-screen suite.
critical_review.test_strength: Mutation tests demand named failing assertions, and the final key mutants run against a passing loopback baseline. Added independent frame-driven production-signal and process-supervision checks to avoid trusting generator passes:true flags or direct-handler assertions alone. N6 identifies a remaining committed-test gap without claiming broken current behavior. N7 identifies the guard mutant's transport setup gap; seed the local base before the guard assertion.
